scripts.build: pnpm workspace-deps && node scripts/sync-runtime-assets.mjs && vite build && node scripts/sync-runtime-assets.mjs --dist
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.dev: pnpm workspace-deps && node scripts/sync-runtime-assets.mjs && cross-env ISAGI_DATA_DIR=../../data/.isagi ISAGI_RUNTIME_DEBUG=1 tsx src/index.ts
scripts.test: pnpm workspace-deps && node scripts/sync-runtime-assets.mjs && node ../../scripts/test-exit-watchdog.mjs 240 -- node --import tsx --import ./test/dump-handles-on-signal.mjs --test --experimental-test-isolation=none "src/**/*.test.ts" "test/**/*.test.ts"
scripts.workspace-deps: pnpm -C ../../packages/workflow-sdk build && pnpm -C ../../packages/workflow-verifier build && pnpm -C ../cli build
